d.t: Water-based, 2-component, polyurethane, clear, matt topcoat for internal decks
d.s: Sikafloor Marine-504 is a water-based, 2-component, polyurethane, clear, matt topcoat for internal decks. It is used as a component of the Sikafloor Marine Deco systems. Sikafloor Marine-504 has been tested in accordance with the FTP Code system and approved in accordance with IMO Marine Equipment Directives.
us: Sikafloor Marine-504 is designed as a component of the Sikafloor Marine Deco systems for internal decks in ship and boat construction. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

sec.t: Properties | | Sikafloor Marine-504 (A) | Sikafloor Marine-504 (B) | | Chemical base | | Acrylic dispersion | Isocyanate | | Colour (CQP001-1) | | White | Transparent | | Density | mixed (+ 5 % H2O) | 1.1 kg/l | 1.1 kg/l | 1.1 kg/l | | Solid content | | 57 % | Mixing ratio | by weight (A:B) | 80 : 20 | Application temperature | substrate / climate | 10 ─ 30 °C A, B | Pot-life | at 10 °C at 20 °C at 30 °C | 50 minutes 30 minutes 20 minutes | Shelf life | | 6 months C | 12 months C | | CQP = Corporate Quality Procedure | A) Substrate must be 3 °C above dew point | B) Maximum 80 % r. h. | C) stored in sealed container in up-right position in a dry place between 5 and 30 °C, protected from direct sunlight |
The curing of Sikafloor Marine-504 takes place by a chemical reaction of the two components. Higher temperatures speed up and lower temperatures slow down the curing process.
For advice on chemical resistance contact the Technical Department of Sika Industry.

Dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by brush or vacuum. Ensure that substrates are clean, dry and free from all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and other surface treatments.

Prior to application confirm relative air humidity and dew point. When starting to coat, make sure the coating rollers are well saturated with product. After proper mixing the product is poured and spread out on the floor in respect of the coat weight. Note: Keep an eye on the pot life since the end of the pot-life is not visible. Roll with a larger 50 cm roller in one direction cross the working direction to eliminate lap-marks. Always consult the most current corresponding Application Manual.

Indications regarding curing details see table below. Tempera- ture | Foot traffic | Light traffic | Full cure 10 °C | 36 hours | 48 hours | 6 days 20 °C | 16 hours | 24 hours | 4 days 30 °C | 12 hours | 18 hours | 3 days

Uncured Sikafloor Marine-504 can be removed from tools and equipment with water. Once cured, the material can only be removed mechanically. Hands and exposed skin have to be washed immediately using hand wipes such as Sika Cleaner-350H or a suitable industrial hand cleaner and water. Do not use solvents on skin.
Freshly applied Sikafloor Marine-504 must be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 5 days. Uncured material reacts in contact with water (foaming).

storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
